answer: Dynamic opportunity-cost bonds force each pseudonym to post collateral that compounds with clone frequency, so a detected Sybil suffers a plume of forfeited stake exceeding its marginal revenue. Because the punishment matrix is subgame-perfect, slashing propagates to descendant identities, erasing any profitable ledge. The fable of free identities collapses: multiplied personas earn strictly negative expected payoff, making honest participation the unique strict Nash equilibrium.
